contests.name: NFL $2.75M Fantasy Football Millionaire [$1M to 1st, $100K Leaderboard Eligible]

experimental.why: the first-place estimate rests on the field sample's extreme tail: with 300,000 sampled lineups against 161,764 entries, one sampled lineup stands for 0.5 entries and the smallest mass the sample can report is 1 in 300,000. Ties are paid the way DraftKings pays them (Stage 3B). The duplicate count is still measured rather than derived: an exact path-summed construction probability now exists for a fixed lineup (dfs_pathprob), but against three million draws it runs about 5% light at the median with one lineup 2.8 standard errors low, so the undercount is neither resolved nor bounded and this link stays shut. Resolution and duplication are what keep these columns experimental. Rank on top 1% and top 0.1%.

field_model.kind: sampled: softmax on projection and price, stack and bring-back rates from the public record
field_model.note: the field is a sample of the public's builds: stack rates from Establish The Run's Milly Maker record, sharpness set so the most-owned player sits at 38%. Dollar figures assume the sim is the truth; read the ranks.

payout.ev_notie: the same expected payout with ties ignored, for the size of the difference
payout.ties: DraftKings splits the tied positions' prizes equally; ev pays that rule over the distribution of how many finish above and level (dfs_tourney.tie_payout)
payout.win_any_pct: first or a share of it

contest.name: NFL $2.75M Fantasy Football Millionaire [$1M to 1st, $100K Leaderboard Eligible]

rules: the quarterback is stacked with at least one of his receivers or tight ends (a back does not count; RB_STACK_TARGETS, a knob, decided after the simulator work)
no defense against our quarterback's team or our running backs' teams
at most 3 from one team; no cap on players from one game (CL_MAX_PER_GAME, a knob, decided after the simulator work)
at most one punt under $3,000, and he must hold a role (RB1-2, WR1-3, TE1)
roster gate: QB1, RB1-2, WR1-3, TE1-2 by Sleeper's depth chart; OUT/IR/doubtful out

simulator.dst: DraftKings DST scored off the same simulated game (points allowed by the other offence, sacks, takeaways, return TDs, safeties, blocks)
simulator.kicker: field goals by distance and tries off the same simulated game
simulator.marginals: not pinned: each player's mean is what the simulated game deals him

passing_volume.target: (1 - w) x the engine's own attempts + w x Sleeper's projected team attempts

simulator.projections: sleeper-weekly (usage shares), drive model + deep engine (team level)
simulator.touchdowns: the engine's, allocated among the men who caught (carried) the ball
